verdict.rationale: A terminal app could plausibly ship direct server connections such as SSH, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an SSH client or any other way to connect outbound to a user's servers. The listed ios_system commands are only lookup tools (nslookup, whois), and the built-in 'relay' is an inbound HTTPS server for running commands in the app, not a way to reach remote servers.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN
